title: Wyoming Tops US Paranormal Rankings as UFO Sightings and Bigfoot Reports Draw Attention
description: Wyoming Tops US Paranormal Rankings as UFO Sightings and Bigfoot Reports Draw Attention Wyoming leads America's most paranormal states as Halloween tourism gains interest, according to new research examining UFO sightings, Bigfoot reports and haunted locations. Vermont, Oregon and Washington follow closely, highlighting regional differences in supernatural folklore and reported experiences that could inspire travellers seeking unusual attractions across the United States. The post Wyoming Tops US Paranormal Rankings as UFO Sightings and Bigfoot Reports Draw Attention appeared first on Travel And Tour World.
